theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovInteriorBond.tr_bondWord_of_interiorMarkov {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.MarkovUnusedGenerator.MarkovTower R A) (hT : InteriorMarkov T) (l : List (ℕ × R × A)) (x : A) :
ChainOK T l → x ∈ T.H (headBond l) → T.tr (bondWord T x l) = (List.map (fun (p : ℕ × R × A) => T.z + p.2.1) l).prod * T.tr (freeWord x l)

theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovInteriorBond.bondWord_mem_upper {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.MarkovUnusedGenerator.MarkovTower R A) (l : List (ℕ × R × A)) (g₀ : ℕ) (d₀ : R) (y : A) :
ChainOK T ((g₀, d₀, y) :: l) → ∀ g ≤ g₀, bondWord T y l ∈ upper T g

theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovInteriorBond.bondWord_mul {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.MarkovUnusedGenerator.MarkovTower R A) (x y : A) (l : List (ℕ × R × A)) :
bondWord T (x * y) l = x * bondWord T y l

theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovInteriorBond.freeWord_mul {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] (x y : A) (l : List (ℕ × R × A)) :

theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovInteriorBond.bondWord_cons {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.MarkovUnusedGenerator.MarkovTower R A) (x : A) (g : ℕ) (d : R) (y : A) (rest : List (ℕ × R × A)) :
bondWord T x ((g, d, y) :: rest) = x * (T.σ g + d • 1) * bondWord T y rest

theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovInteriorBond.freeWord_cons {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] (x : A) (g : ℕ) (d : R) (y : A) (rest : List (ℕ × R × A)) :
freeWord x ((g, d, y) :: rest) = x * freeWord y rest
